hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
echo "=== Deploying Artifact to Tomcat ==="
# Define the absolute path to the build job's target directory BUILD_WAR_PATH="/home/ec2-user/workspace/java-build-job/target/sample-java-app.war"
# Copy the war file using the absolute path from the build job cp "$BUILD_WAR_PATH" /var/lib/tomcat/webapps/ 2>/dev/null || \ sudo cp "$BUILD_WAR_PATH" /usr/share/tomcat/webapps/ 2>/dev/null || \ sudo cp "$BUILD_WAR_PATH" /opt/tomcat/webapps/
echo "=== Fixing Permissions ===" # Grant read & execute permissions so Tomcat can unpack and serve the files properly sudo chmod -R 755 /var/lib/tomcat/webapps/sample-java-app 2>/dev/null || \ sudo chmod -R 755 /usr/share/tomcat/webapps/sample-java-app 2>/dev/null || \ sudo chmod -R 755 /opt/tomcat/webapps/sample-java-app 2>/dev/null
echo "Deployment step completed successfully!"
